Messages.Author: John Ferretti
Messages.Body: Can the Ventrue Headquarters be tapped to gain 3 votes during a blood hunt?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 6 Nov 1999, John Ferretti wrote:

> Can the Ventrue Headquarters be tapped to gain 3 votes during a blood hunt?

Yes.

(Now, for completeness.)

Since it just gives votes, it is valid for tapping during a Blood Hunt.
Something which specificied during a political action would not be (e.g.
most of the other locations).

You can cast votes that any vampire has too. Also, you can play up to 1
(one) political action card from your hand for a vote. You should also be
able to pitch in the edge for one vote, too.

You cannot play action modifiers or reactions, since there is no action to
modify or react to.

--

James Coupe

It is the last step of "resolving diablerie" [6.5.5.5].

It occurs right after the diabolist gets a skill card (or, if he doesn't
get a skill card, right after the victim is burned).
